contend.en: The authors contend that the observed decline reflects policy changes rather than weather.
contend.zh: 作者们主张，观察到的下降反映的是政策变化而非天气。

contend.en: Critics contend that the sample was too small to support such a broad conclusion.
contend.zh: 批评者争辩说，样本太小，不足以支持如此宽泛的结论。

contend.en: Several scholars contend that definitions of literacy vary across cultures.
contend.zh: 几位学者主张，对文化素养的定义因文化而异。

concede.en: The author concedes that the effect size is modest but insists it is meaningful.
concede.zh: 作者承认效应量不大，但坚持认为它有意义。

concede.en: Even opponents concede that the reform improved transparency in public procurement.
concede.zh: 即便是反对者也承认，这项改革提高了公共采购的透明度。

concede.en: The researchers concede the limitations of their design and call for replication.
concede.zh: 研究者们承认其设计的局限，并呼吁进行重复验证。

rebut.en: The paper rebuts earlier claims with a much larger dataset.
rebut.zh: 该论文用大得多的数据集驳斥了先前的主张。

rebut.en: Two commentaries sought to rebut the methodology of the original study.
rebut.zh: 两篇评论试图反驳原研究的方法。

rebut.en: The panel rebutted the accusation that the results had been selectively reported.
rebut.zh: 专家组驳斥了结果被选择性报告的指责。

affirm.en: The follow-up study affirmed the link between sleep and memory consolidation.
affirm.zh: 后续研究确认了睡眠与记忆巩固之间的联系。

affirm.en: The court affirmed the principle that data subjects must give informed consent.
affirm.zh: 法院确认了数据主体必须给予知情同意的原则。

affirm.en: Interviews with teachers affirmed the questionnaire findings.
affirm.zh: 对教师的访谈证实了问卷的结果。

allege.en: The report alleges that the laboratory bypassed standard ethical review.
allege.zh: 该报告指控该实验室绕过了标准的伦理审查。

allege.en: It is alleged that the firm manipulated emissions data for several years.
allege.zh: 据称，该公司多年来一直操纵排放数据。

allege.en: The article alleges conflicts of interest among several panel members.
allege.zh: 该文章指控数名小组成员存在利益冲突。

purport.en: The technique purports to measure implicit attitudes without self-report.
purport.zh: 该技术号称能在没有自我报告的情况下测量内隐态度。

purport.en: Several apps purport to improve attention, yet few publish evaluation data.
purport.zh: 一些应用号称能改善注意力，但很少公布评估数据。

purport.en: The document purports to summarize a decade of field observations.
purport.zh: 该文件自称总结了十年的实地观察。

signify.en: In this diagram, a dashed line signifies an indirect pathway.
signify.zh: 在此图中，虚线表示间接路径。

signify.en: A rising vacancy rate may signify weakening demand in the local economy.
signify.zh: 空置率上升可能意味着当地经济需求走弱。

signify.en: The gesture signifies agreement in some cultures and refusal in others.
signify.zh: 这一手势在某些文化中表示同意，在另一些文化中表示拒绝。

presuppose.en: The argument presupposes that respondents interpret the scale in the same way.
presuppose.zh: 该论证预设受访者以相同方式理解这份量表。

presuppose.en: Interview methods presuppose a degree of trust between researcher and participant.
presuppose.zh: 访谈方法预设研究者与参与者之间有一定程度的信任。

presuppose.en: Cost-benefit analysis presupposes that all outcomes can be assigned monetary values.
presuppose.zh: 成本效益分析预设所有结果都能被赋予货币价值。

accelerate.en: Urbanization has accelerated the loss of surrounding farmland.
accelerate.zh: 城市化加速了周边农田的流失。

accelerate.en: Rising temperatures accelerate the melting of mountain glaciers.
accelerate.zh: 气温上升加速了山地冰川的消融。

accelerate.en: Digital tools can accelerate the analysis of large text corpora.
accelerate.zh: 数字工具可以加速对大型文本语料的分析。

exacerbate.en: Fuel subsidies often exacerbate air pollution in dense cities.
exacerbate.zh: 燃料补贴常常加剧密集城市的空气污染。

exacerbate.en: The staffing shortage exacerbated delays in patient discharge.
exacerbate.zh: 人手短缺加剧了患者出院的延误。

exacerbate.en: Policy makers must avoid measures that exacerbate regional inequality.
exacerbate.zh: 政策制定者必须避免加剧区域不平等的举措。

aggravate.en: Poorly timed interventions can aggravate rather than ease the crisis.
aggravate.zh: 时机不当的干预可能加重而非缓解危机。

aggravate.en: The study found that noise exposure aggravates sleep disturbances in children.
aggravate.zh: 研究发现噪声暴露会加重儿童的睡眠障碍。

aggravate.en: Cutting maintenance budgets aggravated the deterioration of the road network.
aggravate.zh: 削减养护预算加重了道路网的劣化。

escalate.en: Trade disputes escalated into broader restrictions on technology transfer.
escalate.zh: 贸易争端升级为对技术转移更广泛的限制。

escalate.en: The cost of clinical trials has escalated over the past two decades.
escalate.zh: 临床试验的成本在过去二十年里不断攀升。

escalate.en: Officials worried that local protests might escalate into national unrest.
escalate.zh: 官员们担心地方抗议可能升级为全国性的骚动。

stagnate.en: Real wages stagnated for a decade despite steady productivity growth.
stagnate.zh: 尽管生产率持续增长，实际工资却停滞了十年。

stagnate.en: The sector stagnated after subsidies were withdrawn in the early 2000s.
stagnate.zh: 21 世纪初补贴取消后，该行业陷入停滞。

stagnate.en: Firms in the region stagnated as investment flowed elsewhere.
stagnate.zh: 随着资金流向别处，该地区的企业陷入停滞。

oscillate.en: The pendulum oscillates with a period that depends on its length.
oscillate.zh: 摆锤以取决于其长度的周期振荡。

oscillate.en: Public opinion oscillated between support for and distrust of the program.
oscillate.zh: 公众舆论在对该计划的支持与不信任之间摇摆。

oscillate.en: Lake levels oscillate seasonally in response to rainfall patterns.
oscillate.zh: 湖泊水位随降水模式发生季节性波动。

plummet.en: Enrollment plummeted after tuition fees were doubled.
plummet.zh: 学费翻倍后，入学人数骤降。

plummet.en: Confidence in the currency plummeted during the debt crisis.
plummet.zh: 债务危机期间对该货币的信心暴跌。

plummet.en: The population of the species plummeted following habitat fragmentation.
plummet.zh: 栖息地破碎化之后，该物种的种群数量骤减。

soar.en: Housing prices soared in metropolitan areas during the boom.
soar.zh: 繁荣时期大都市地区的房价飙升。

soar.en: Demand for rare earth metals has soared with the growth of electric vehicles.
soar.zh: 随着电动汽车的增长，对稀土金属的需求猛增。

soar.en: Publication output soared after the journal moved to open access.
soar.zh: 该期刊转为开放获取后，发文量猛增。

dwindle.en: Funding for basic research dwindled as priorities shifted to applied projects.
dwindle.zh: 随着重心转向应用项目，基础研究经费逐渐减少。

dwindle.en: The committee's membership dwindled from twenty to six.
dwindle.zh: 委员会成员从二十人缩减到六人。

dwindle.en: Aquifer reserves are dwindling faster than they can be replenished.
dwindle.zh: 含水层的储量消耗得比补充的速度还快。

abate.en: The epidemic did not abate until widespread vaccination began.
abate.zh: 直到广泛开展疫苗接种，疫情才有所减缓。

abate.en: Public opposition showed no sign of abating.
abate.zh: 公众的反对毫无减弱的迹象。

abate.en: Wind speeds abated sufficiently for the survey flights to resume.
abate.zh: 风速减弱到足以让测量飞行恢复。

prolong.en: Delays in diagnosis prolong hospital stays and raise costs.
prolong.zh: 诊断延误延长住院时间并推高成本。

prolong.en: The therapy can prolong survival in advanced stages of the disease.
prolong.zh: 该疗法可以延长疾病晚期的生存期。

prolong.en: Bureaucratic approval procedures prolonged the preparation period before fieldwork by a year.
prolong.zh: 官僚式的审批程序使实地调查前的准备期拖长了一年。

spiral.en: Debt spiraled as interest payments consumed an ever larger share of revenue.
spiral.zh: 随着利息支出占收入的份额越来越大，债务螺旋式攀升。

spiral.en: Costs spiraled out of control before the project was halted.
spiral.zh: 项目叫停之前，成本已失控攀升。

spiral.en: The paper traces how distrust between groups can spiral into open conflict.
spiral.zh: 论文追溯了群体间的不信任如何螺旋式演变为公开冲突。
